verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official TypeScript SDK. Documented examples show `task.trigger()`, `triggerAndWait()`, run handles for status, cancel and retry, and `new TriggerClient({...})` for multi-project and environment access, plus SDK-authenticated management APIs, with a versioned SDK lifecycle (v3 end-of-life, v4 current). Community users confirm building on it day to day in their TypeScript codebases, though one reports v3-to-v4 migration friction with docs still showing deprecated code. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), up-to-date migration docs, and direct frontend triggering without a proxy.
